title: Dispatch: 19.4.6 operations and activation faithful-or-absent (S2+S3) (attempt 1)
description: First of two sequential children of eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6 (read it, its notes, bd memory magic-item-faithful-or-absent, and the full subsystem review eshyra-o9bd.19.4.5.7 notes - identifiers corrected in parts 4 and 6). BRANCH BASE: this branch is cut from PR #653's head (eshyra-o9bd.19.4.5) to reuse its verbatim-span infrastructure (adjudicated-by-design clauses with required sourceText; magicItemAdjudicatedEffects.ts withholding pattern). SCOPE: review groups S2 (operations/activation omit or invent printed delivery/eligibility predicates; S2.01-S2.45) and S3 (generic action/toggle defaults: invented activation costs; S3.01-S3.10), plus the operation-side items folded in from eshyra-vcm3 (Nine Lives Stealer slay-on-critical.cost unconditional charge -> only if slain; Rod of Lordly Might drain-life/paralyze activation trigger needs 'a creature'; Hammer giant-slaying activation trigger; Ring of Shooting Stars launch). OUT OF SCOPE (second child): S4 state graphs/timers, S5 entityGrant lifecycle/control, S6 economies/composition other than the Nine Lives charge, containment S1.16-S1.18. RULE: each typed operation/activation field states the printed predicate exactly, or is not typed: (a) where existing fields can carry the printed condition exactly (e.g. activation.cost 'bonus-action' where printed; a printed holding/on-your-person requirement), make it exact; (b) an activation cost the text does not state is NOT typed (no invented 'action' default): omit the typed cost and record an adjudicated-by-design clause with a verbatim sourceText span of the activation sentence; (c) an invented prerequisite (Dagger of Venom 'dagger is coated' on coat-blade) is removed; (d) a printed predicate no field can carry exactly -> adjudicated-by-design clause with verbatim span (extend the withholding pattern to operations; do not invent new free-text predicate fields). Glamoured Studded Leather (S3.01, absorbed eshyra-b0m4): bonus action as printed; no invented restore operation if the source permits only 'use this property again or remove the armor'. RUNTIME SAFETY: use_item executes operations whose readiness is green; before changing or removing any operation/field, check every consumer (packages/core/src/orchestrator/toolUseItem.ts, toolSpendUsage.ts, toolResetUsage.ts, state/itemState.ts, itemExecutionReadiness.ts, usageCounters.ts, itemResetExecutor.ts, discovery) and keep green operations working; if an operation must stay executable, make it exact rather than absent and report it. Evidence: extend the generalized source-agreement checks to operations/activation (no typed activation cost or requirement the printed text does not state; verbatim spans for every adjudicated clause), representative eligible/ineligible scenarios per root cause - not per-item reproducers. Regenerate pack (npm run import:dnd5e-srd -- --out packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1) and inventory (npx tsx packages/core/scripts/inventory-semi-structured-boundary.ts); npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack. Importer protocol; never edit records.json directly. Host memory: wait until pgrep -fc '^node .*verify-current-worktree' prints 0 or 1; npm run verify:worktree && git commit. Notes: member table (member id, path, exact/absent/removed, source phrase) and the consumer check; close this bead. No push/PR.
notes: COMPLETION (commit 121aed5d on branch eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6.1, not pushed). Mechanism: packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemFaithfulOperations.ts (reviewed table over the producers, wired in magicItemFamilyRegistry for parent and variant scopes). activation.cost is now optional in MagicItemActivationSpec/validator (no default cost; empty activation rejected). requirement/trigger/target set by the table are VERBATIM description spans (compile fails otherwise); every dropped cost has an adjudicated-by-design clause with a verbatim sourceText span (compile fails otherwise). Adjudicated clauses carry the owning family's tag so the reviewed tag census is unchanged. Glamoured Studded Leather fixed in the producer (bonus action as printed; restore-appearance operation removed; active->active via set-appearance, active->inactive on 'remove the armor'). Wand of Wonder randomProcedure trigger now the verbatim printed sentence (holding it). CONSUMER CHECK: use_item/itemState/itemExecutionReadiness/toolSpendUsage/toolResetUsage/usageCounters/itemResetExecutor/discovery read only operation id, cost (economies), excludes, doesNotExpend, effects; none reads activation. Adjudicated clauses have no block so they are never readiness blockers. Executable set computed by running deriveItemOperationReadinessInput+assertMagicItemOperationReady over all 490 item/variant/operation combos before and after: 19 ready both before and after, identical (Ammunition hit-target, Boots of Levitation cast-levitate, Candle burn, 14 Ioun Stone grab-orbiting-stone variants, Ring of Shooting Stars discharge-ball-lightning, Rope of Entanglement escape-rope); only diff is the removed Glamoured restore-appearance (was blocked). Pack diff: 57 magic-item records only (no other kind); readiness green 212 / engine-pending 793 unchanged, adjudicated 11->54. Evidence: packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemOperationSourceAgreement.test.ts (lexical cost/word screen over covered items, verbatim-span check for every table-set field, clause presence, counterfactual drift throws, per-root-cause scenarios, runtime-ready set). verify:dnd5e-srd-pack and verify:worktree green (356 files passed, 6606 tests).
